## Problem and result

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Scope

- [ ] The change follows the existing application/policy/provider boundaries.
- [ ] No secrets, private state, source archives, or unrelated work are included.
- [ ] Public documentation and both README languages agree where affected.

## Validation

List the exact revision/configuration and relevant checks. Separate synthetic
transport, actual local runtime, and actual provider results. Explain unverified
behavior and any migration, compatibility, or recovery implications.

## Evidence

For UI changes, show sanitized before/after captures from a disposable session.
For other changes, include the smallest useful example or regression result.
